name: EG Template — 7-variant Envelope Generator
description: A versatile envelope generator preset built on the MK2's native 4-stage envelope tile (`dx7envelope`), re-rendered dynamically by Lua to present **7 different envelope types** from a single control:

name: Ephemera Sequencer
description: A proof-of-concept **1-track, 16-step melodic sequencer** running on Electra One's standalone Lua firmware. Touch or knobs to edit notes, hardware buttons for transport.

name: XT Envelopes — Custom envelope editor
description: A custom control that demonstrates the `paint` / `touch` / `pot` callback system on the Electra One MK2. Implements two envelope modes (`WAVE` 8-point, `FREE` 4-point) with active-point editing, color-coded stages and touch dragging.

name: XY Pad
description: Two-axis touch pad. Touch/drag on the screen → two normalized values (0..1) sent via an `onChange(x, y)` hook, which you wire to whatever MIDI messages you want (CCs, NRPNs, SysEx).
